scenario_text: A small body moves in a bound orbit around a much heavier central body under mutual gravitational attraction, tracked in a plane. The inward pull depends on the inverse square of separation and continuously bends the trajectory. Given an initial position and velocity, the body traces its orbital path over time. The dynamics depend on the central mass and the gravitational constant.
